fun print(vararg angles: Double) {
    val names = arrayOf("Degrees", "Gradians", "Mils", "Radians")
    val rnd = { a: Double -> round(a * 10000.0) / 10000.0 }
    val normal = arrayOf(
        { a: Double -> normalizeDeg(a) },
        { a: Double -> normalizeGrad(a) },
        { a: Double -> normalizeMil(a) },
        { a: Double -> normalizeRad(a) }
    )
 
    val convert = arrayOf(
        arrayOf({ a: Double -> a }, { a: Double -> degToGrad(a) }, { a: Double -> degToMil(a) }, { a: Double -> degToRad(a) }),
        arrayOf({ a: Double -> gradToDeg(a) }, { a: Double -> a }, { a: Double -> gradToMil(a) }, { a: Double -> gradToRad(a) }),
        arrayOf({ a: Double -> milToDeg(a) }, { a: Double -> milToGrad(a) }, { a: Double -> a }, { a: Double -> milToRad(a) }),
        arrayOf({ a: Double -> radToDeg(a) }, { a: Double -> radToGrad(a) }, { a: Double -> radToMil(a) }, { a: Double -> a })
    )
 
    println("%-12s%-12s%-12s%-12s%-12s%-12s%-12s".format("Angle", "Normalized", "Unit", "Degrees", "Gradians", "Mils", "Radians"))
 
    for (angle in angles) {
        for (i in 0..3) {
            val nAngle = normal[i](angle)
 
            println(
                "%-12.4f%-12.4f%-12s%-12.4f%-12.4f%-12.4f%-12.4f".format(
                    rnd(angle),
                    rnd(nAngle),
                    names[i],
                    rnd(convert[i][0](nAngle)),
                    rnd(convert[i][1](nAngle)),
                    rnd(convert[i][2](nAngle)),
                    rnd(convert[i][3](nAngle))
                )
            )
        }
    }
}
 
fun normalizeDeg(angle: Double): Double = normalize(angle, 360.0)
fun normalizeGrad(angle: Double): Double = normalize(angle, 400.0)
fun normalizeMil(angle: Double): Double = normalize(angle, 6400.0)
fun normalizeRad(angle: Double): Double = normalize(angle, 2 * PI)
 
fun normalize(angle: Double, N: Double): Double {
    var a = angle
    while (a <= -N) a += N
    while (a >= N) a -= N
    return a
}

fun polyRegression(x: IntArray, y: IntArray) {
    val xm = x.average()
    val ym = y.average()
    val x2m = x.map { it * it }.average()
    val x3m = x.map { it * it * it }.average()
    val x4m = x.map { it * it * it * it }.average()
    val xym = x.zip(y).map { it.first * it.second }.average()
    val x2ym = x.zip(y).map { it.first * it.first * it.second }.average()
 
    val sxx = x2m - xm * xm
    val sxy = xym - xm * ym
    val sxx2 = x3m - xm * x2m
    val sx2x2 = x4m - x2m * x2m
    val sx2y = x2ym - x2m * ym
 
    val b = (sxy * sx2x2 - sx2y * sxx2) / (sxx * sx2x2 - sxx2 * sxx2)
    val c = (sx2y * sxx - sxy * sxx2) / (sxx * sx2x2 - sxx2 * sxx2)
    val a = ym - b * xm - c * x2m
 
    fun abc(xx: Int) = a + b * xx + c * xx * xx
 
    println("y = $a + ${b}x + ${c}x^2\n")
    println(" Input  Approximation")
    println(" x   y     y1")
    for ((xi, yi) in x zip y) {
        System.out.printf("%2d %3d  %5.1f\n", xi, yi, abc(xi))
    }
}

        is Short -> true
        is Byte -> true
        is Complex -> f.imag == 0.0 && f.real.toLong() == f.real.toLong()
        else -> false

class Vector3D(val x: Double, val y: Double, val z: Double) {
    infix fun dot(v: Vector3D) = x * v.x + y * v.y + z * v.z
 
    infix fun cross(v: Vector3D) =
        Vector3D(y * v.z - z * v.y, z * v.x - x * v.z, x * v.y - y * v.x)
 
    fun scalarTriple(v: Vector3D, w: Vector3D) = this dot (v cross w)
 
    fun vectorTriple(v: Vector3D, w: Vector3D) = this cross (v cross w)
 
    fun toString() = "($x, $y, $z)"
}

fun findCoeffs(p0: Pos, p1: Pos, p2: Pos): Coeffs {
    val x1 = p0.row.toDouble()
    val x2 = p1.row.toDouble()
    val x3 = p2.row.toDouble()
    val y1 = p0.col.toDouble()
    val y2 = p1.col.toDouble()
    val y3 = p2.col.toDouble()

    val a = y1 / ((x1 - x2) * (x1 - x3)) + y2 / ((x2 - x1) * (x2 - x3)) + y3 / ((x3 - x1) * (x3 - x2))

    val b = (-y1 * (x2 + x3) / ((x1 - x2) * (x1 - x3))
            - y2 * (x1 + x3) / ((x2 - x1) * (x2 - x3))
            - y3 * (x1 + x2) / ((x3 - x1) * (x3 - x2)))

    val c = (y1 * x2 * x3 / ((x1 - x2) * (x1 - x3))
            + y2 * x1 * x3 / ((x2 - x1) * (x2 - x3))
            + y3 * x1 * x2 / ((x3 - x1) * (x3 - x2)))

    return Coeffs(a, b, c)
};0

fun coerceToExpected(value: Any?): Any? {
    /*
    Return 'foo' if `value` is truthy; otherwise return `value` itself.
    In Kotlin, 'falsy' means: null, false, 0 (Int/Double/Float/Long), "" (empty String), empty list, empty set, empty map.
    */
    return when (value) {
        null -> null
        is Boolean -> if (!value) value else "foo"
        is Int -> if (value == 0) value else "foo"
        is Double -> if (value == 0.0) value else "foo"
        is Float -> if (value == 0.0f) value else "foo"
        is Long -> if (value == 0L) value else "foo"
        is String -> if (value.isEmpty()) value else "foo"
        is List<*> -> if (value.isEmpty()) value else "foo"
        is Set<*> -> if (value.isEmpty()) value else "foo"
        is Map<*, *> -> if (value.isEmpty()) value else "foo"
        else -> "foo"
    }
};1

fun calculateTimeDifference(timestamp1: String, timestamp2: String): String {
    val formatter = DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss")
    val event1 = LocalDateTime.parse(timestamp1, formatter)
    val event2 = LocalDateTime.parse(timestamp2, formatter)
    val duration = Duration.between(event1, event2)
    val totalSeconds = abs(duration.seconds)
    val days = abs(duration.toDays())
    val hours = (totalSeconds % (24 * 3600)) / 3600
    val minutes = (totalSeconds % 3600) / 60
    val seconds = totalSeconds % 60
    return "$days days, $hours hours, $minutes minutes, $seconds seconds"
};1

class KotlinPendulum {
    private val _form = JFrame("Pendulum").apply {
        width = 200
        height = 200
    }
    private val _timer = Timer(30, null)
 
    private var _angle = Math.PI / 2
    private var _angleAccel = 0.0
    private var _angleVelocity = 0.0
    private val _dt = 0.1
 
    private val _length = 50
 
    init {
        _timer.addActionListener(object : ActionListener {
            fun actionPerformed(e: ActionEvent?) {
                val anchorX = (_form.width / 2) - 12
                val anchorY = _form.height / 4
                val ballX = anchorX + (sin(_angle) * _length).toInt()
                val ballY = anchorY + (cos(_angle) * _length).toInt()
 
                _angleAccel = -9.81 / _length * sin(_angle)
                _angleVelocity += _angleAccel * _dt
                _angle += _angleVelocity * _dt
 
                val dblBuffer = java.awt.image.BufferedImage(_form.width, _form.height, java.awt.image.BufferedImage.TYPE_INT_RGB)
                val g = dblBuffer.createGraphics()
                val f = _form.graphics
 
                g.drawLine(anchorX, anchorY, ballX, ballY)
                g.fillOval(anchorX - 3, anchorY - 4, 7, 7)
                g.fillOval(ballX - 7, ballY - 7, 14, 14)
 
                f.clearRect(0, 0, _form.width, _form.height)
                f.drawImage(dblBuffer, 0, 0, null)
            }
        })
 
        _timer.start()
        _form.isVisible = true
    }
}

val rand = Random()
const val RAND_MAX = 32767
const val NUL = '\u0000'
 
val x = 15
val y = 15
var grid = StringBuilder((x + 1) * (y + 1) + 1)
var cell = 0
var end = 0
var m = 0
var n = 0
 
fun makeGrid(p: Double) {
    val thresh = (p * RAND_MAX).toInt()
    m = x
    n = y
    grid.setLength(0)  // clears grid
    grid.setLength(m + 1)  // sets first (m + 1) chars to NUL
    end = m + 1
    cell = m + 1
    for (i in 0 until n) {
        for (j in 0 until m) {
            val r = rand.nextInt(RAND_MAX + 1)
            grid.append(if (r < thresh) '+' else '.')
            end++
        }
        grid.append('\n')
        end++
    }
    grid[end - 1] = NUL
    end -= ++m  // end is the index of the first cell of bottom row
}
 
fun ff(p: Int): Boolean { // flood fill
    if (grid[p] != '+') return false
    grid[p] = '#'
    return p >= end || ff(p + m) || ff(p + 1) || ff(p - 1) || ff(p - m)
}
 
fun percolate(): Boolean {
    var i = 0
    while (i < m && !ff(cell + i)) i++
    return i < m
}

fun cumulativeTotal(n: Int): Int {
    /*
     * Compute the cumulative total of the cubes of all whole numbers from 1 to n (inclusive).
     *
     * The sum of the first n cubes has a well-known closed-form formula:
     *     1³ + 2³ + ... + n³ = (n(n + 1) / 2)^2
     *
     * Parameters
     * ----------
     * n : Int
     *     A positive integer indicating the upper bound of the range.
     *
     * Returns
     * -------
     * Int
     *     The cumulative total of cubes from 1 to n.
     */
    if (n < 1) {
        throw IllegalArgumentException("n must be a positive integer")
    }
    // Use the closed-form formula for efficiency
    val total = ((n * (n + 1)) / 2).toLong().let { (it * it).toInt() }
    return total

fun uniqueElements(arr: List<Int>): List<Int> {
    /**
     * Return a list containing only the first occurrence of each integer
     * from the input list, preserving the original order.
     *
     * Parameters
     * ----------
     * arr : List<Int>
     *     The list of integers that may contain duplicates.
     *
     * Returns
     * -------
     * List<Int>
     *     A new list with duplicates removed, keeping the order of first appearance.
     */
    val seen = mutableSetOf<Int>()        // Keeps track of integers we've already added.
    val result = mutableListOf<Int>()     // Stores the unique elements in order.

    for (num in arr) {
        if (num !in seen) {
            seen.add(num)
            result.add(num)
        }
    }

    return result

fun calculateFinalPrice(price: Double, discount: Double): Pair<Double, Double> {
    /*
    Calculate the final price after applying a percentage discount.

    Parameters
    ----------
    price : Double
        The original price of the product. Must be non-negative.
    discount : Double
        Discount percentage to apply. Values outside 0–100 are clamped to that range.

    Returns
    -------
    Pair<Double, Double>
        A pair containing:
        • finalPrice – the price after the discount is applied
        • amountSaved – how much money was saved relative to the original price
    */
    if (price < 0) {
        throw IllegalArgumentException("price must be non-negative")
    }
    // Clamp discount to the valid percentage range 0–100
    val validDiscount = discount.coerceIn(0.0, 100.0)
    val amountSaved = price * (validDiscount / 100.0)
    val finalPrice = price - amountSaved
    return Pair(finalPrice, amountSaved)
};1

fun buildCompleteTree(count: Int): TreeNode? {
    if (count == 0) return null

    var value = 1
    val root = TreeNode(value)
    val queue = LinkedList<TreeNode>()
    queue.add(root)

    var remain = count - 1
    while (remain > 0) {
        val node = queue.pollFirst()

        value++
        node.left = TreeNode(value)
        queue.addLast(node.left)
        remain--

        if (remain <= 0) return root

        value++
        node.right = TreeNode(value)
        queue.addLast(node.right)
        remain--
    }

    return root
};0

fun extractPageRange(payload: String): Pair<Int, Int> {
    /*
     * Extract the start_page and end_page from a
     * 'binder_update_page_range(start_page, end_page, current_page, total_pages)'
     * command string.
     *
     * Parameters
     * ----------

     * -------
     * Pair<Int, Int>
     *     (start_page, end_page)
     *
     * Throws
     * ------
     * IllegalArgumentException
     *     If the string does not match the expected format.
     */
    val pattern = Pattern.compile(
        "^\\s*binder_update_page_range\\s*\\(\\s*(-?\\d+)\\s*,\\s*(-?\\d+)\\s*,\\s*(-?\\d+)\\s*,\\s*(-?\\d+)\\s*\\)\\s*$"
    )
    val matcher = pattern.matcher(payload)
    if (!matcher.matches()) {
        throw IllegalArgumentException("Invalid payload format")
    }
    val startPage = matcher.group(1).toInt()
    val endPage = matcher.group(2).toInt()
    return Pair(startPage, endPage)
};1

fun factorial(n: Int): Long {
    /*
    Compute n! (the factorial of n) using a while loop.

    Parameters
    ----------
    n : Int
        A non-negative integer.
    Returns
    -------
    Long
        The factorial of n.
    Throws
    ------
    IllegalArgumentException
        If n is negative.
    IllegalArgumentException
        If n is not an integer. (Handled by type system)
    */
    if (n < 0) {
        throw IllegalArgumentException("n must be non-negative")
    }
    var result: Long = 1
    var counter: Int = 1
    while (counter <= n) {
        result *= counter.toLong()
        counter += 1
    }
    return result
};1

 * @typedef {{
 *    x: (!number),
 *    y: (!number)
 * }}
 */
typealias pointType = Point
 
/**
 * @param {!Array<pointType>} l
 * @param {number} eps
 */
fun RDP(l: List<Point>, eps: Double): List<Point> {
  val last = l.size - 1
  val p1 = l[0]
  val p2 = l[last]
  val x21 = p2.x - p1.x
  val y21 = p2.y - p1.y
 
  val (dMax, x) = l.slice(1 until last)
     .map { p -> Math.abs(y21 * p.x - x21 * p.y + p2.x * p1.y - p2.y * p1.x) }
     .withIndex()
     .maxBy { it.value }!!
 
  return if (dMax > eps) {
    RDP(l.slice(0 until x.index + 1), eps) + RDP(l.slice(x.index until l.size), eps).slice(1 until l.size)
  } else {
    listOf(l[0], l[last])
  }
}

/**
 * 100/100
 * Kadane's algorithm
 * @param A
 * @return
 */
fun solution(A: IntArray): Int {
    var maxSlice = A[0]
    var maxEnding = A[0]
    /**
     * For each position, we compute the largest sum that ends in that position
     * If we assume that the maximum sum of a slice ending in position i equals maxEnding
     * then the maximum slice ending in position i equals max(A[i], maxEnding + A[i])
     * All this is basically an implementation of Kadane’s algorithm:
     * https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Maximum_subarray_problem#Kadane's_algorithm
     */
    for (i in 1 until A.size) {
        maxEnding = Math.max(A[i], maxEnding + A[i])
        maxSlice = Math.max(maxEnding, maxSlice)
    }
    return maxSlice
};0

    /*
    Given two lists of equal length, `yopt` (ignored in the computation) and
    `scaledRes`, return a new list where each element is the square root of the
    absolute value of the corresponding element in `scaledRes`.

    Parameters
    ----------
    yopt : List<Double>
        List of estimated values (not used in the calculation but kept to satisfy
        the required function signature).
    scaledRes : List<Double>
        List of scaled residuals.

    List<Double>
        List containing sqrt(abs(value)) for every value in `scaledRes`.

    Example
    -------
    computeScaledResiduals(listOf(1.0, 2.0), listOf(-4.0, 9.0)) // returns listOf(2.0, 3.0)

    if (yopt.size != scaledRes.size) {

    return scaledRes.map { Math.sqrt(Math.abs(it)) }

/** Calculate intersection of two lines.
    \return true if found, false if not found or error
*/
fun LineLineIntersect(x1: Double, y1: Double, // Line 1 start
    x2: Double, y2: Double, // Line 1 end
    x3: Double, y3: Double, // Line 2 start
    x4: Double, y4: Double, // Line 2 end
    ixOut: Double, iyOut: Double // Output
): Boolean {
    val detL1 = Det(x1, y1, x2, y2)
    val detL2 = Det(x3, y3, x4, y4)
    val x1mx2 = x1 - x2
    val x3mx4 = x3 - x4
    val y1my2 = y1 - y2
    val y3my4 = y3 - y4
 
    val denom = Det(x1mx2, y1my2, x3mx4, y3my4)
    if (denom == 0.0) { // Lines don't seem to cross
        ixOut = Double.NaN
        iyOut = Double.NaN
        return false
    }
 
    val xnom = Det(detL1, x1mx2, detL2, x3mx4)
    val ynom = Det(detL1, y1my2, detL2, y3my4)
    ixOut = xnom / denom
    iyOut = ynom / denom
    if (!isFinite(ixOut) ||!isFinite(iyOut)) { // Probably a numerical issue
        return false
    }
 
    return true //All OK
}

    return when {
        this == num -> true
        this.isNaN() || num.isNaN() -> false
        this == Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY || num == Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY -> false
        this == Double.NEGATIVE_INFINITY || num == Double.NEGATIVE_INFINITY -> false

 * originating [Collection]. This makes sure that
 * - No values less than two are used as limit (since at least two values are needed for a trend)
 * - Limits of odd size is corrected to an even size (so each sub list has an equal amount of elements)

 */
fun computeTakeFromLimit(size: Int, limit: Int): Int
{
    if(limit <= 1)
        throw IllegalArgumentException("Argument limit must be a greater than one but was $limit")

fun solve(
    tunnel: String,
    remainingTunnels: List<String>,
    time: Int,
    flow: Int,
    pressure: Int,
    pathDistances: Map<String, Map<String, Int>>,
    flowRates: Map<String, Int>,
    limit: Int,
): Int {
    // initial pressure for current time and flow
    var maxPressure = pressure + (limit - time) * flow
    remainingTunnels.forEach { newTunnel ->
        val travelAndOpenTime = pathDistances.getValue(tunnel).getValue(newTunnel) + 1
        if (time + travelAndOpenTime >= limit) return@forEach
        val newTime = time + travelAndOpenTime
        val newPressure = pressure + travelAndOpenTime * flow
        val newFlow = flow + flowRates.getValue(newTunnel)
        val newRemainingTunnels = remainingTunnels - newTunnel
        val newScore = solve(newTunnel, newRemainingTunnels, newTime, newFlow, newPressure, pathDistances, flowRates, limit)
        if (newScore > maxPressure) {
            maxPressure = newScore
        }
    }
    return maxPressure
};0

enum class Direction {
    LEFT, UP, RIGHT, DOWN
}
 
fun main(args: Array<String>) {
    val scanner = Scanner(System.`in`)
    val datalength = 100
    val data = IntArray(datalength)
    var dp = 0
    var ipx = 0
    var ipy = 0
    var direction = Direction.RIGHT
    var running = true
    var stack = Stack<Triple<Int, Int, Direction>>()
    var lines = arrayOf(
            "/==!/======ECHO==,==.==#",
            "|   |",
            "\$==>==@/==@/==<==#")
    var lmax = lines.maxBy { it.length }!!.length
    lines = lines.map { it.padEnd(lmax) }.toTypedArray()
    for (y in lines.indices) {
        if (lines[y].indexOf("\$")!= -1) {
            ipx = lines[y].indexOf("\$")
            ipy = y
        }
    }
    val instruction = mapOf(
            '>' to { dp++ },
            '<' to { dp-- },
            '+' to { data[dp]++ },
            '-' to { data[dp]-- },
            ',' to { data[dp] = scanner.next().toInt() },
            '.' to { print(data[dp].toChar()) },
            '/' to {
                var d = direction.ordinal
                d += if (d % 2 == 0) 3 else 5
                direction = Direction.values()[d % 4]
            },
            '\\' to {
                var d = direction.ordinal
                d += if (d % 2 == 0) 1 else -1
                direction = Direction.values()[d]
            },
            '!' to { ipnext() },
            '?' to { if (data[dp] == 0) ipnext() },
            '@' to { stack.push(Triple(ipx, ipy, direction)) },
            '#' to { if (stack.size > 0) { val (x, y, d) = stack.pop(); ipx = x; ipy = y; direction = d } },
            '\n' to { running = false })
    fun inboundsx(plus: Boolean) = if (plus) ipx < lmax else ipx > 1
    fun inboundsy(plus: Boolean) = if (plus) ipy < lines.size else ipy > 1
    fun ipnext() {
        if (direction == Direction.RIGHT && inboundsx(true)) ipx++
        else if (direction == Direction.LEFT && inboundsx(false)) ipx--
        else if (direction == Direction.DOWN && inboundsy(true)) ipy++
        else if (direction == Direction.UP && inboundsy(false)) ipy--
    }
    while (running) {
        val cmdcode = lines[ipy][ipx]
        if (instruction.containsKey(cmdcode)) instruction[cmdcode]!!.invoke()
        ipnext()
    }
    System.exit(data[dp])
};1

fun twoSumRec(

    seenValues: Map<Int, Int> = emptyMap()

/**
 * Finds a peak element's index in the provided list of integers
 *
 * Algorithm:
 * - Initializes left as the start index of the list and right as the end index of the list (len(nums)- 1).
 * - Perform binary search until left becomes equal to right.
 * - Calculate the middle index mid using the formula mid = left + (right - left) // 2. or mid = (left + right) >> 1
 * - Compare nums[mid] with nums[mid + 1] to determine if the peak is on the left side or the right side of mid.
 *     - If nums[mid] is greater than nums[mid + 1], move the right index to mid, indicating that the peak is on the
 *     left side.
 *     - Otherwise, move the left index to mid + 1, indicating that the peak is on the right side.
 * - Repeat steps 3-4 until left becomes equal to right.
 * - Return the value of peak_index, which represents the index of the peak element.
 *
 * Complexity:
 *
 * - Time complexity O(log n): Where n is the number of elements in the nums vector.
 * - Space Complexity O(1): Since it uses a constant amount of extra space.
 *
 * @param nums [IntArray] list of integers with duplicate peaks
 * @return [Int] index of a peak element(i.e. element that is greater than its adjacent neighbours)
 */
fun findPeakElement(nums: IntArray): Int {
    var left = 0
    var right = nums.size - 1
    var peakIndex = -1

    while (left <= right) {
        val mid = (left + right).shr(1)

        val potentialPeak = nums[mid]

        if (mid == nums.size - 1 || potentialPeak > nums[mid + 1]) {
            peakIndex = mid
            right = mid - 1
        } else {
            left = mid + 1
        }
    }

    return peakIndex
};0

    operator fun plus(other: Complex) = Complex(real + other.real, imag + other.imag)
 
    operator fun times(other: Complex) = Complex(
        real * other.real - imag * other.imag,
        real * other.imag + imag * other.real
    )
 
    fun inv(): Complex {
        val denom = real * real + imag * imag
        return Complex(real / denom, -imag / denom)
    }
 
    operator fun unaryMinus() = Complex(-real, -imag)
 
    operator fun minus(other: Complex) = this + (-other)
 
    operator fun div(other: Complex) = this * other.inv()
 
    fun conj() = Complex(real, -imag)
 
    fun toString() =
        if (imag >= 0.0) "$real + ${imag}i"
        else "$real - ${-imag}i"
}

fun main() {
    val sampleRate = 44100
    val duration = 8
    val dataLength = sampleRate * duration
    val hdrSize = 44
    val fileLen = dataLength + hdrSize - 8
 
    // buffers
    val buf1 = ByteArray(1)
    val buf2 = ByteArray(2)
    val buf4 = ByteArray(4)
 
    // WAV header
    val sb = StringBuilder()
    sb.append("RIFF")
    ByteBuffer.wrap(buf4).order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN).putInt(fileLen)
    sb.append(buf4) // file size - 8
    sb.append("WAVE")
    sb.append("fmt ")
    ByteBuffer.wrap(buf4).order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN).putInt(16)
    sb.append(buf4) // length of format data (= 16)
    ByteBuffer.wrap(buf2).order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN).putShort(1)
    sb.append(buf2) // type of format (= 1 (PCM))
    sb.append(buf2) // number of channels (= 1)
    ByteBuffer.wrap(buf4).order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN).putInt(sampleRate)
    sb.append(buf4) // sample rate
    sb.append(buf4) // sample rate * bps(8) * channels(1) / 8 (= sample rate)
    sb.append(buf2) // bps(8) * channels(1) / 8  (= 1)
    ByteBuffer.wrap(buf2).order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN).putShort(8)
    sb.append(buf2) // bits per sample (bps) (= 8)
    sb.append("data")
    ByteBuffer.wrap(buf4).order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN).putInt(dataLength)
    sb.append(buf4) // size of data section
    val wavhdr = sb.toString().toByteArray()
 
    // write WAV header
    val f = File("notes.wav")
    val fos = FileOutputStream(f)
    fos.write(wavhdr)
 
    // compute and write actual data
    val freqs = doubleArrayOf(261.6, 293.6, 329.6, 349.2, 392.0, 440.0, 493.9, 523.3)
    for (j in 0 until duration) {
        val freq = freqs[j]
        val omega = 2 * PI * freq
        for (i in 0 until dataLength / duration) {
            val y = 32 * sin(omega * i / sampleRate)
            buf1[0] = y.roundToInt().toByte()
            fos.write(buf1)
        }
    }
    fos.close()
};1

fun m(i: Int, w: Int): Triple<MutableList<Item>, Int, Int> {
    val chosen = mutableListOf<Item>()
    if (i < 0 || w == 0) return Triple(chosen, 0, 0)
    else if (wants[i].weight > w) return m(i - 1, w)
    val (l0, w0, v0) = m(i - 1, w)
    var (l1, w1, v1) = m(i - 1, w - wants[i].weight)

    val n = splits.size
    val paths2 = paths.drop(1)
    var k = 0
    var common = ""
    while (true) {

        common += if (k == 0) splits[0] else separator + splits[k]
        if (!paths2.all { it.startsWith(common + separator) || it == common } ) return prevCommon
        if (++k == n) return common
    }
}

data class Circle(val x: Double, val y: Double, val r: Double)
 
val Double.sq get() = this * this
 
fun solveApollonius(c1: Circle, c2: Circle, c3: Circle,
                    s1: Int, s2: Int, s3: Int): Circle {
    val (x1, y1, r1) = c1
    val (x2, y2, r2) = c2
    val (x3, y3, r3) = c3
 
    val v11 = 2 * x2 - 2 * x1
    val v12 = 2 * y2 - 2 * y1
    val v13 = x1.sq - x2.sq + y1.sq - y2.sq - r1.sq + r2.sq
    val v14 = 2 * s2 * r2 - 2 * s1 * r1
 
    val v21 = 2 * x3 - 2 * x2
    val v22 = 2 * y3 - 2 * y2
    val v23 = x2.sq - x3.sq + y2.sq - y3.sq - r2.sq + r3.sq
    val v24 = 2 * s3 * r3 - 2 * s2 * r2
 
    val w12 = v12 / v11
    val w13 = v13 / v11
    val w14 = v14 / v11
 
    val w22 = v22 / v21 - w12
    val w23 = v23 / v21 - w13
    val w24 = v24 / v21 - w14
 
    val p = -w23 / w22
    val q =  w24 / w22
    val m = -w12 * p - w13
    val n =  w14 - w12 * q
 
    val a = n.sq +  q.sq - 1
    val b = 2 * m * n - 2 * n * x1 + 2 * p * q - 2 * q * y1 + 2 * s1 * r1
    val c = x1.sq + m.sq - 2 * m * x1 + p.sq + y1.sq - 2 * p * y1 - r1.sq
 
    val d = b.sq - 4 * a * c
    val rs = (-b - Math.sqrt(d)) / (2 * a)
    val xs = m + n * rs
    val ys = p + q * rs
    return Circle(xs, ys, rs)
}

fun isWithinBounds(query: List<Int>, source: List<Int>): Boolean {
    /**
     * Check if every element of `query` is less than or equal to the corresponding
     * element in `source`.
     *
     * Parameters
     * ----------
     * query : List<Int>
     *     List of integers to be checked.
     * source : List<Int>
     *     List of upper bounds (same length as `query`).
     *
     * Returns
     * -------
     * Boolean
     *     True if all elements in `query` are within bounds.
     *
     * Throws
     * ------
     * IndexOutOfBoundsException
     *     If any element in `query` exceeds its corresponding element in `source`.
     * IllegalArgumentException
     *     If the two lists have different lengths (defensive check).
     */
    if (query.size != source.size) {
        throw IllegalArgumentException("`query` and `source` must be the same length.")
    }
    for ((idx, pair) in query.zip(source).withIndex()) {
        val (q, s) = pair
        if (q > s) {
            throw IndexOutOfBoundsException(
                "Element at position $idx exceeds bound: query[$idx]=$q > source[$idx]=$s"
            )
        }
    }
    return true
};1

fun knapsack(w: Int): IntArray {
    val m  = Array(n + 1) { IntArray(w + 1) }
    for (i in 1..n) {
        for (j in 0..w) {
            m[i][j] = m[i - 1][j]
            for (k in 1..items[i - 1].count) {
                if (k * items[i - 1].weight > j) break
                val v = m[i - 1][j - k * items[i - 1].weight] + k * items[i - 1].value
                if (v > m[i][j]) m[i][j] = v
            }
        }
    }
    val s = IntArray(n)
    var j = w
    for (i in n downTo 1) {
        val v = m[i][j]
        var k = 0
        while (v != m[i - 1][j] + k * items[i - 1].value) {
            s[i - 1]++
            j -= items[i - 1].weight
            k++
        }
    }
    return s
}

fun boundingBox(points: List<Triple<Int, Int, Int>>, cubeSize: Int): Tuple6<Int, Int, Int, Int, Int, Int> {
    if (points.isEmpty()) return Tuple6(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0)
    var xMin = Int.MAX_VALUE
    var xMax = Int.MIN_VALUE
    var yMin = Int.MAX_VALUE
    var yMax = Int.MIN_VALUE
    var zMin = Int.MAX_VALUE
    var zMax = Int.MIN_VALUE
    for ((x, y, z) in points) {
        val cubeXStart = (Math.floorDiv(x, cubeSize)) * cubeSize
        val cubeXEnd = cubeXStart + cubeSize
        if (cubeXStart < xMin) xMin = cubeXStart
        if (cubeXEnd > xMax) xMax = cubeXEnd
        val cubeYStart = (Math.floorDiv(y, cubeSize)) * cubeSize
        val cubeYEnd = cubeYStart + cubeSize
        if (cubeYStart < yMin) yMin = cubeYStart
        if (cubeYEnd > yMax) yMax = cubeYEnd
        val cubeZStart = (Math.floorDiv(z, cubeSize)) * cubeSize
        val cubeZEnd = cubeZStart + cubeSize
        if (cubeZStart < zMin) zMin = cubeZStart
        if (cubeZEnd > zMax) zMax = cubeZEnd
    }
    return Tuple6(xMin, yMin, zMin, xMax, yMax, zMax)

fun checkIfHailstonesCross(hailstones: List<Hailstone>, delta1: Double, delta2: Double) {
    val pathsToCheck = hailstones.mapIndexed { x, hailstone ->
        (x + 1..<hailstones.size).map { y ->
            hailstone to hailstones[y]
        }
    }.flatten()

    val intersections = pathsToCheck.count { (hailstone1, hailstone2) ->
        val x1 = delta1
        val x2 = delta2
        val y1 = hailstone1.extrapolateY(x1)
        val y2 = hailstone1.extrapolateY(x2)

        val x3 = delta1
        val x4 = delta2
        val y3 = hailstone2.extrapolateY(x3)
        val y4 = hailstone2.extrapolateY(x4)

        val x12 = x1 - x2
        val x34 = x3 - x4
        val y12 = y1 - y2
        val y34 = y3 - y4

        val c = x12 * y34 - y12 * x34
        val a = x1 * y2 - y1 * x2
        val b = x3 * y4 - y3 * x4

        val x = (a * x34 - b * x12) / c
        val y = (a * y34 - b * y12) / c

        val inAreaIntersect = x in delta1..delta2 && y in delta1..delta2

        val isIntersectFutureOfH1 = hailstone1.velocity.first < 0 && x < hailstone1.initialPosition.first ||
                hailstone1.velocity.first > 0 && x > hailstone1.initialPosition.first
        val isIntersectFutureOfH2 = hailstone2.velocity.first < 0 && x < hailstone2.initialPosition.first ||
                hailstone2.velocity.first > 0 && x > hailstone2.initialPosition.first

        inAreaIntersect && isIntersectFutureOfH1 && isIntersectFutureOfH2

fun getSSLContext(p12Path: String, password: String): SSLContext {
    val ks = KeyStore.getInstance("pkcs12")
    val fis = FileInputStream(p12Path)
    val pwd = password.toCharArray()
    ks.load(fis, pwd)
    val kmf = KeyManagerFactory.getInstance("PKIX")
    kmf.init(ks, pwd)
    val sc = SSLContext.getInstance("TLS")
    sc.init(kmf.keyManagers, null, null)
    return sc
}

fun shortestExit(grid: List<String>, min: Int, max: Int): Int {
    val start = Index(0, 0)
    val end = Index(grid[0].lastIndex, grid.lastIndex)
    val dx = intArrayOf(1, 0, -1, 0)
    val dy = intArrayOf(0, 1, 0, -1)
    val plane = List(grid.size) { IntArray(grid[0].length) { Int.MAX_VALUE } }
    val queue = PriorityQueue<ClumsyPath> { a, b -> a.cost - b.cost }
    queue.offer(ClumsyPath(start, Index(0, 0), 0, 0))
    val visited = hashSetOf<Triple<Index, Index, Int>>()

    while (queue.isNotEmpty()) {
        val (to, direction, directionCount, cost) = queue.poll()
        plane[to.y][to.x] = cost
        if (to == end) break
        dy.indices.forEach { i ->
            val nextDirection = Index(dx[i], dy[i])
            val multiplier = if (direction == nextDirection) 1 else min
            val next = Index(to.x + dx[i] * multiplier, to.y + dy[i] * multiplier)
            plane.getOrNull(next.y)?.getOrNull(next.x) ?: return@forEach
            if (nextDirection == Index(direction.x * -1, direction.y * -1)) return@forEach
            val newCount = if (direction == nextDirection) directionCount + 1 else multiplier
            if (newCount > max) return@forEach
            if (!visited.add(Triple(next, nextDirection, newCount))) return@forEach
            var moves = '0' - grid[to.y][to.x]
            for (x in minOf(next.x, to.x)..maxOf(next.x, to.x)) for (y in minOf(next.y, to.y)..maxOf(next.y, to.y)) {
                moves += grid[y][x] - '0'
            }
            queue.add(ClumsyPath(next, nextDirection, newCount, cost + moves))
        }
    }
    return plane[end.y][end.x]
};0

fun String.padCenter(n: Int): String {
    val len = this.length
    if (n <= len) return this
    return this.padStart((n + len) / 2).padEnd(n)
}
 
fun calculateEaster(year: Int): GregorianCalendar {
    val a = year % 19
    val b = year / 100
    val c = year % 100
    val d = b / 4
    val e = b % 4
    val f = (b + 8) / 25
    val g = (b - f + 1) / 3
    val h = (19 * a + b - d - g + 15) % 30
    val i = c / 4
    val k = c % 4
    val l = (32 + 2 * e + 2 * i - h - k) % 7
    val m = (a + 11 * h + 22 * l) / 451
    val n = h + l - 7 * m + 114
    val month = n / 31 - 1  // months indexed from 0
    val day = (n % 31) + 1
    return GregorianCalendar(year, month, day)
}
 
fun outputHolidays(year: Int) {
    val date = calculateEaster(year)
    print("%4d  ".format(year))
    var po = 0
    for ((h, o) in holidayOffsets) {
        date.add(Calendar.DATE, o - po)
        po = o
        print("${"%1\$td %1\$tb".format(date).padCenter(h.length)}  ")
    }
    println()
}

fun intersectPoint(
    rayVector: Vector3D,
    rayPoint: Vector3D,
    planeNormal: Vector3D,
    planePoint: Vector3D
): Vector3D {
    val diff  = rayPoint - planePoint
    val prod1 = diff dot planeNormal
    val prod2 = rayVector dot planeNormal

    return rayPoint - rayVector * prod3

fun knapsack(i: Int, value: Double, weight: Double, volume: Double) {
    if (i == n) {
        if (value > bestValue) {
            bestValue = value
            for (j in 0 until n) best[j] = count[j]
        }
        return
    }
    val m1 = Math.floor(weight / items[i].weight).toInt()
    val m2 = Math.floor(volume / items[i].volume).toInt()
    val m  = minOf(m1, m2)
    count[i] = m
    while (count[i] >= 0) {
        knapsack(
            i + 1,
            value  + count[i] * items[i].value,
            weight - count[i] * items[i].weight,
            volume - count[i] * items[i].volume
        )
        count[i]--
    }
}

fun run_utm(
        state: String? = null,
        blank: String? = null,
        rules: List<List<String>> = listOf(),
        tape: List<String> = listOf(),
        halt: String? = null,
        pos: Int = 0) {
    var st = state
    if (tape.isEmpty()) tape = listOf(blank)
    if (pos < 0) pos += tape.size
    if (pos >= tape.size || pos < 0) throw Error("bad init position")
    val rules = rules.map { it[0] to it[1] to (it[2] to it[3] to it[4]) }.toMap()

    while (true) {
        print("$st\t")
        for (i in tape.indices) {
            if (i == pos) print("[$tape[i]]")
            else print(tape[i])
        }
        println()

        if (st == halt) break
        if (st to tape[pos]!in rules) break

        val (v1, dr, s1) = rules[st to tape[pos]]!!
        tape[pos] = v1
        if (dr == "left") {
            if (pos > 0) pos--
            else tape.add(0, blank)
        }
        if (dr == "right") {
            pos++
            if (pos >= tape.size) tape.add(blank)
        }
        st = s1
    }
}

fun checkDist(gen: () -> Int, nRepeats: Int, tolerance: Double = 0.5) {
    val occurs = mutableMapOf<Int, Int>()
    for (i in 1..nRepeats) {
        val d = gen()
        if (occurs.containsKey(d))
            occurs[d] = occurs[d]!! + 1
        else
            occurs.put(d, 1)
    }
    val expected = (nRepeats.toDouble()/ occurs.size).toInt()
    val maxError = (expected * tolerance / 100.0).toInt()
    println("Repetitions = $nRepeats, Expected = $expected")
    println("Tolerance = $tolerance%, Max Error = $maxError\n")
    println("Integer   Occurrences   Error  Acceptable")
    val f = "  %d        %5d      %5d     %s"
    var allAcceptable = true
    for ((k,v) in occurs.toSortedMap()) {
        val error = Math.abs(v - expected)
        val acceptable = if (error <= maxError) "Yes" else "No"
        if (acceptable == "No") allAcceptable = false
        println(f.format(k, v, error, acceptable))
    }
    println("\nAcceptable overall: ${if (allAcceptable) "Yes" else "No"}")
}

    var words = wordsZ + str.filter({ it -> it.isLetter() })              // Filter only Letters From String

fun hue_to_rgb(hue: Double, sat: Double, p: ByteArray) {
    var x: Double
    val c = 255 * sat
    hue /= 60
    x = (1 - abs(fmod(hue, 2) - 1)) * 255
 
    when (hue.toInt()) {
        0 -> {
            p[0] = c.toByte()
            p[1] = x.toByte()
            p[2] = 0
        }
        1 -> {
            p[0] = x.toByte()
            p[1] = c.toByte()
            p[2] = 0
        }
        2 -> {
            p[0] = 0
            p[1] = c.toByte()
            p[2] = x.toByte()
        }
        3 -> {

            p[1] = x.toByte()
            p[2] = c.toByte()

class ArchimedeanSpiral : JPanel() {
    init {
        preferredSize = Dimension(640, 640)
        background = Color.white
    }
 
    fun drawGrid(g: Graphics2D) {
        g.color = Color(0xEEEEEE)
        g.stroke = BasicStroke(2f)
        val angle = Math.toRadians(45.0)
        val w = width
        val center = w / 2
        val margin = 10
        val numRings = 8
        val spacing = (w - 2 * margin) / (numRings * 2)
 
        for (i in 0 until numRings) {
            val pos = margin + i * spacing
            val size = w - (2 * margin + i * 2 * spacing)
            g.drawOval(pos, pos, size, size)
            val ia = i * angle
            val x2 = center + (Math.cos(ia) * (w - 2 * margin) / 2).toInt()
            val y2 = center - (Math.sin(ia) * (w - 2 * margin) / 2).toInt()
            g.drawLine(center, center, x2, y2)
        }
    }
 
    fun drawSpiral(g: Graphics2D) {
        g.stroke = BasicStroke(2f)
        g.color = Color.magenta
        val degrees = Math.toRadians(0.1)
        val center = width / 2
        val end = 360 * 2 * 10 * degrees
        val a = 0.0
        val b = 20.0
        val c = 1.0
        var theta = 0.0
        while (theta < end) {
            val r = a + b * Math.pow(theta, 1.0 / c)
            val x = r * Math.cos(theta)
            val y = r * Math.sin(theta)
            plot(g, (center + x).toInt(), (center - y).toInt())
            theta += degrees
        }
    }
 
    fun plot(g: Graphics2D, x: Int, y: Int) {
        g.drawOval(x, y, 1, 1)
    }
 
    fun paintComponent(gg: Graphics) {
        super.paintComponent(gg)
        val g = gg as Graphics2D
        g.setRenderingHint(RenderingHints.KEY_ANTIALIASING, RenderingHints.VALUE_ANTIALIAS_ON)
        drawGrid(g)
        drawSpiral(g)
    }
}

fun simulateMovement(steps: Int): Pair<Int, Int> {
    /*
    Simulate a 2-D random walk of `steps` steps.
    The particle starts at the origin (0, 0).
    Each step it moves exactly one unit in one of the four cardinal
    directions with equal probability.

    Parameters
    ----------
    steps : Int
        Number of steps to simulate.  If steps is 0 or negative,
        the particle does not move.

    Returns
    -------
    Pair<Int, Int>
        The (x, y) coordinates of the particle after the walk.
    */
    var x = 0
    var y = 0

    val moves = mapOf(
        0 to Pair(1, 0),   // right
        1 to Pair(-1, 0),  // left
        2 to Pair(0, 1),   // up
        3 to Pair(0, -1)   // down
    )

    for (i in 0 until maxOf(0, steps)) {
        val (dx, dy) = moves[Random.nextInt(0, 4)]!!
        x += dx
        y += dy
    }
    return Pair(x, y)
};1

    /*

        The number of times all the frames in the cycle (considered as "other"

    var xx = x

        9.9843695780195716e-6,

    xx--
    var a = p[0]

    for (i in 1 until p.size) a += p[i] / (xx + i)

fun filterBoundingBoxes(bboxes: List<List<Int>>, cropArea: List<Int>, inCropThreshold: Double): List<List<Int>> {
    val (cx1, cy1, cx2, cy2) = cropArea
    val kept = mutableListOf<List<Int>>()
    for (box in bboxes) {
        val (x1, y1, x2, y2) = box
        val boxW = (x2 - x1).coerceAtLeast(0)
        val boxH = (y2 - y1).coerceAtLeast(0)
        val boxArea = boxW * boxH
        if (boxArea == 0) continue
        val ix1 = maxOf(x1, cx1)
        val iy1 = maxOf(y1, cy1)
        val ix2 = minOf(x2, cx2)
        val iy2 = minOf(y2, cy2)
        val iw = (ix2 - ix1).coerceAtLeast(0)
        val ih = (iy2 - iy1).coerceAtLeast(0)
        val interArea = iw * ih
        if (interArea.toDouble() / boxArea.toDouble() >= inCropThreshold) {
            kept.add(box)
        }
    }

fun String.jaro(other: String): Double {
    if (this.isEmpty() && other.isEmpty()) return 1.0
    val maxMatchDistance = this.length.coerceAtLeast(other.length) / 2 - 1
    val thisMatchArray = BooleanArray(this.length)
    val otherMatchArray = BooleanArray(other.length)
    var matches = 0
    for (i in this.indices) {
        val start = 0.coerceAtLeast(i - maxMatchDistance)
        val end = (i + maxMatchDistance + 1).coerceAtMost(other.length)
        (start until end).find { j -> !otherMatchArray[j] && this[i] == other[j] }?.let {
            thisMatchArray[i] = true
            otherMatchArray[it] = true
            matches++
        }
    }
    if (matches == 0) return 0.0
    var t = 0.0
    var k = 0
    (this.indices).filter { thisMatchArray[it] }.forEach { i ->
        while (!otherMatchArray[k]) k++
        if (this[i] != other[k]) t += 0.5
        k++
    }

    val m = matches.toDouble()
    return (m / this.length + m / other.length + (m - t) / m) / 3.0

fun deconv(g: DoubleArray, f: DoubleArray): DoubleArray {
    val fs = f.size
    val h = DoubleArray(g.size - fs + 1)
    for (n in h.indices) {
        h[n] = g[n]
        val lower = if (n >= fs) n - fs + 1 else 0
        for (i in lower until n) h[n] -= h[i] * f[n -i]
        h[n] /= f[0]
    }
    return h
}

fun maxSubarraySum(nums: List<Int>): Int {
    /*
     * Returns the maximum possible sum of a contiguous subarray within `nums`.
     * If `nums` is empty, returns 0.
     *
     * Uses Kadane's algorithm:
     * - Iterate through the array while keeping track of the best subarray sum
     *   that ends at the current index (`currentSum`) and the best seen so far (`bestSum`).
     * - Update `currentSum` as the larger of the current element alone
     *   or extending the previous subarray with the current element.
     * - Update `bestSum` whenever a larger subarray sum is found.
     *
     * Time complexity: O(n)
     * Space complexity: O(1)
     */
    if (nums.isEmpty()) return 0

    var currentSum = nums[0]
    var bestSum = nums[0]
    for (i in 1 until nums.size) {
        val num = nums[i]
        currentSum = maxOf(num, currentSum + num)
        bestSum = maxOf(bestSum, currentSum)
    }
    return bestSum
};1

object IsinValidator {
    private val isinRegex = Pattern.compile("^[A-Z]{2}[A-Z0-9]{9}\\d$")
 
    fun isValidIsin(isin: String): Boolean =
        isinRegex.matcher(isin).matches() && luhnTest(digitize(isin))
 
    fun digitize(isin: String): String =
        isin.map { digitValue(it) }.joinToString("")
 
    fun luhnTest(number: String): Boolean =
        number.reversed().mapIndexed { i, c -> summand(digitValue(c), i) }.sum() % 10 == 0
 
    fun summand(digit: Int, i: Int): Int =
        digit + (i % 2) * (digit - digit / 5 * 9)
 
    fun digitValue(c: Char): Int =
        if (c in '0'..'9') c - '0' else c - 'A' + 10
}

    /*

    val status = mutableListOf<Int>()

/**
 * To understand the solution, we remember the following two points from math:
 *
 * All whole numbers can be represented by 2N (even) and 2N+1 (odd).
 * For a given binary number, multiplying by 2 is the same as adding a zero at the end (just as we just add a zero when
 * multiplying by ten in base 10).
 * Since multiplying by 2 just adds a zero, then any number and its double will have the same number of 1's. Likewise,
 * doubling a number and adding one will increase the count by exactly 1. Or:
 *
 * countBits(N) = countBits(2N)
 * countBits(N)+1 = countBits(2N+1)
 *
 * Thus, we can see that any number will have the same bit count as half that number, with an extra one if it's an odd
 * number. We iterate through the range of numbers and calculate each bit count successively in this manner:
 *
 *   for (i in 0 until num) {
 *      counter[i] = counter[i // 2] + i % 2
 *   }
 *
 * With a few modifications:
 *
 * - Define the base case of counter[0] = 0, and start at 1.
 * - We need to include num, so use num+1 as the bound on the range.
 * - Bit-shifting 1 has the same effect as dividing by 2, and is faster, so replace i // 2 with i >> 1.
 * - We can choose to either initiate our list with counter = [0] * (num+1) or just counter = [0] and then append to it
 * (which has O(1)). It's a little faster to initiate it with zeroes and then access it rather than appending each time,
 * but I've chosen the latter for better readability.
 * - Some solutions use i & 1 to determine the parity of i. While this accomplishes the same purpose as i % 2 and keeps
 * with the bitwise-operator theme, it is faster to calculate the modulus.
 *
 * Time and Space Complexity
 * Time: O(n) - We iterate through the range of numbers once.
 * Space: O(n) - We use a num-sized array.
 */
fun countBits(n: Int): IntArray {
    val counter = IntArray(n + 1) { 0 }
    for (i in 1 until n + 1) {
        counter[i] = counter[i.shr(1)] + i % 2
    }
    return counter

fun exec(text: String, mode: Mode, showSteps: Boolean = false): String {
    var left = L_ALPHABET
    var right = R_ALPHABET
    val eText = CharArray(text.length + 1)
    val temp = CharArray(27)
 
    for (i in 0 until text.length) {

        val index = if (mode == Mode.ENCRYPT) right.indexOf(text[i]) else left.indexOf(text[i])

        for (j in index until 26) temp[j - index] = left[j]
        for (j in 0 until index) temp[26 - index + j] = left[j]
        var store = temp[1]
        for (j in 2 until 14) temp[j - 1] = temp[j]
        temp[13] = store
        left = temp.joinToString("")
 
        // permurte right
 
        for (j in index until 26) temp[j - index] = right[j]
        for (j in 0 until index) temp[26 - index + j] = right[j]
        store = temp[0]
        for (j in 1 until 26) temp[j - 1] = temp[j]
        temp[25] = store
        store = temp[2]

        right = temp.joinToString("")

fun compoundDuration(n: Int): String {

    val weeks  : Int

    val hours  : Int
    val minutes: Int
    val seconds: Int
    var divisor: Int = 7 * 24 * 60 * 60
    var rem    : Int
    var result = ""
 
    weeks = n / divisor
    rem   = n % divisor
    divisor /= 7
    days  = rem / divisor
    rem  %= divisor
    divisor /= 24
    hours = rem / divisor
    rem  %= divisor
    divisor /= 60
    minutes = rem / divisor
    seconds = rem % divisor
 
    if (weeks > 0)   result += "$weeks wk, "
    if (days > 0)    result += "$days d, "
    if (hours > 0)   result += "$hours hr, "
    if (minutes > 0) result += "$minutes min, "
    if (seconds > 0)
        result += "$seconds sec"
    else
        result = result.substring(0, result.length - 2)
    return result

        val dx = x2 - x1
        val dy = y1 - y2
 
        val x3 = x2 - dy
        val y3 = y2 - dx
        val x4 = x1 - dy

            lineTo(x4, y4)

        g.fill(square)

        val triangle = Path2D.Float()
